senses.nuances: noun 仅标示下列例句中对字符串的名词性提及，不是为该片段确立词性。英语 doesn't 是 does not 的缩写，但其词义和读音不能直接移给 doesn。以下为文本核对场景的示例，不是固定搭配；马来语释义不是 DBP 原文。

dual_scenarios.context: 编辑报告 / 文本核对
dual_scenarios.ms: Rentetan “doesn” perlu disemak berdasarkan teks asal sebelum sebarang pembetulan dibuat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 作出任何修改前，须依据原文核对字符串“doesn”。
dual_scenarios.en: The string “doesn” must be checked against the original text before any correction is made.

dual_scenarios.en: It just says “doesn” here. Shall we check the original first?

etymology.historical_story: English doesn't contracts does not, combining an auxiliary verb with negation. The supplied sequence doesn lacks the ending of that established spelling. Truncation or token splitting could explain it, but that remains an inference. Without the original passage, the fragment has no recoverable history that can responsibly be presented as Malay etymology. [Source for doesn't: Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/doesn-t?topic=yes-no-and-not).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: doesn 看起来像“还没写完”：先核对原文，再决定是否还原为 doesn't；不要把片段背成马来语单词。
